messages:
marie: Dropped a compact-mode exploration focusing on two things: a unit toggle (Tokens <-> USD) and an invoice download dropdown (PDF/CSV). Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/unique/usage-compact-units :point_up_2: sam: Love the unit toggle idea. Quick Q: when toggled to USD, do we show a mini-legend with the Token->USD rate? That helps finance people trust the numbers. jo: Yes please. Mini-legend should be subtle under the header: "Rate: 1 token = $0.004 (est.)" and link to a tooltip that explains calculation (cache vs billed). Put it behind an info icon. kai: Accessibility note: the toggle needs an accessible label and keyboard focus ring that is visible in high contrast themes. Also ensure the tooltip is reachable via keyboard and announced. devon: Backend note: showing USD requires real-time exchange of tokens->dollar multiplier per-org (billing config). That is an extra call. We could fetch the rate with the same usage payload to avoid a second request. Also invoice CSV export needs a query param to include token breakdowns. marie: For launch, I propose we default to Tokens but show the unit toggle. If org has custom billing rate, show a small badge "custom rate" and allow CSV export with raw tokens column. sam: UX nit: invoice CTA should be a compact dropdown (three-dot chevron) on the row that expands to "Download PDF", "Download CSV", "View invoice". Keeps row tidy vs full ghost button. But also add a per-panel primary invoice CTA for bulk actions. jo: On compact rows we also need to choose density: "dense" (28px rows) vs "cozy" (40px). Dense lets you fit more projects but hurts tap targets. Maybe put density in user preferences and default to cozy on mobile. kai: Keyboard focus: ensure each row's download menu is reachable via a single Tab to the row then Enter to open menu. Use aria-haspopup and aria-expanded. Example pattern: ```
...
``` That keeps screen reader semantics clear. devon: Performance: adding per-row menus increases DOM nodes. Use a single floating menu and move it into place on open instead of rendering one per row. Also pool sparklines into a shared canvas for dense mode. marie: Microcopy: Instead of "Tokens" label show "Est. tokens" and for USD mode "Est. USD (incl. cache)" so we surface uncertainty. Also add an italic footnote for billed vs estimated on invoice view. sam: Another microcopy tweak: menu item "Download CSV (tokens + USD)" makes it explicit. design-scheduler: Reminder: design sync Monday 9:30am. Agenda: unit toggle, invoice dropdown, density options, accessibility fixes. marie: Action items: Jo update artboards with unit toggle + mini-legend + invoice dropdown patterns; Devon implement floating menu prototype + canvas sparklines; Kai write keyboard/aria checklist; Sam test microcopy length at 320px. Back on Monday. :+1:
